name: Chemical Trap

description.content: After repairing [20%] of Generators, you can trap a Dropped Pallet for [100s]. All Survivors see that Pallet's Aura for that time.
When the Killer breaks that Pallet, the trap explodes and they gain [50%] [Hindered] for [4s].

quote: "How do we kill it, Ash?" -Ellen Ripley
